# Retained attribution record

Upstream: https://github.com/harfe/fixed-point-theorems-lean4
Revision: `770940ddf9878cf61952ed53d910b92bca841838`.
Copyright (c) 2026 harfe; the upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`.

The previously vendored five Lean modules supplied Brouwer's theorem for
Johnson's sphere-homeomorphism corollary. That corollary was deleted from the
current manuscript. Dependency analysis established that all five modules were
exclusive to it, and they were removed with the author's approval. No active
Lean source imports this directory. These attribution records are preserved;
the former implementation remains available in repository history where recorded.
